title: On Quantum Obstructions in Type IIA Orientifolds
summary: Quantum corrections can severely modify or even remove classical infinite distance limits in four-dimensional gravity theories with minimal N=1 supersymmetry. In this note we study this effect for infinite distance directions in the classical Kähler moduli sector of Type IIA orientifolds at fixed four-dimensional dilaton. We present several independent arguments why such infinite distance directions are absent at the quantum level.
